methodology.variantA: Frozen capital-enabled v1 at N>=3; exact face.3 final bid transform only at N2 Vickrey
methodology.variantB: Exact face.1 final bid transform at N>=3; same face.3 as A at N2 Vickrey
methodology.opponentCaveat: Public-data-inspired stress archetypes, not reconstructions of actual rivals. Three original starters use the same reliable external driver.
methodology.setup: Actual team/credential creation, registration, start, all Swiss, top cut, elimination and three-game final/crown reducers. No phase or status shortcuts.
methodology.lifecycle: One owned policy/optimizer cache per bot across all matches; shared immutable frozen dictionary index in official wordlist order, matching the production loader. Separate longest-first words only for original starters. Fresh bot policies/database per paired variant/tournament.
methodology.inputs: Own authenticated myRack only; public balances/auction/history; actual per-table participant count, including 6,5,4,3,2.
methodology.scheduler: Words/bids for every table in the next common closing group finish before advancing the clock once. Only precollected due tables tick; automatic next Swiss deals remain inside the final prior-round reducer.
methodology.rng: Seed before initial start, each actual phase/round/table-slot/window tick, and each required manual finals start. Later RNG tile streams can diverge between A/B as actions change.
methodology.measuredPosition: Rotates position%18 within each batch; same seed and position across A/B. A six-seed pilot covers only positions0–5;18/36-seed batches cover all positions once/twice.
methodology.scoreAndPlace: Swiss rank captured at cut before later scores; non-cut overall place derived from Swiss rank, serverFinalFinishPosition remains null. Crown uses three final scores, then whole-tournament total, then lower id.
methodology.terminal: All entrants external; existing rack may cash before last close, no policy/action after final award. bagTotal0 bids suppressed by driver.
methodology.timing: Measured synchronous decision wall time; >100ms is conservative offline overrun, separate from production 150ms worker/transport gate.
methodology.limitations: Fixed archetype mix and finite paired sample do not prove live tournament strength. Wall-clock bounded searches can differ near deadlines. No worker/network tests here.
methodology.promotion: Report only; independent format experiment. The failed six-player primary score gate remains unchanged; criteria and confirmation must be separately predeclared.
